description: This file defines the GrainStorageSerializer class which implements IGrainStorageSerializer interface. It provides methods for serializing and deserializing grain state data, delegating to preferred and fallback serializers.

classes.name: GrainStorageSerializer
classes.description: A class that serializes and deserializes grain state data, delegating to preferred and fallback serializers.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes input data using the preferred serializer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes input data, attempting preferred serializer first, then fallback, and throwing an exception if both fail.
